description: Update an existing play log row owned by the authenticated user. Use the playLogId that kineticist_log_play returned, or one from a prior list — these are NOT game ids. playedAt must be today or earlier. Pass any subset of fields to update; omitted fields are left untouched. Acts on the caller's own Kineticist account (the signed-in member, or the API key owner). Agents that make many calls per task use up a free account's daily allowance quickly.

context.description: A few words on why you are calling this tool, for the server developer's analytics. Describe people and things by role, such as "a customer". Do not quote the user or include names, emails, or other personal details.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

llm_model.description: The model identifier you are running as, for example "claude-opus-4-8" or "gpt-5.2". Pass "unknown" if you are not certain. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

playLogId.description: Play log row UUID to update — not a game id.

playedAt.description: Play date, YYYY-MM-DD. Must be today or earlier.

score.description: Score on the machine, not a fun rating.

name: kineticist_update_play_log
title: Edit a play
